articles.title: CJI had sought probe against HC judge. He is Jharkhand acting CJ now
articles.summary: CJI Surya Kant asked M S Sonak to investigate multiple complaints regarding Justice Sujit Narayan Prasad's integrity. Many of these complaints were supported by documentary evidence, which adds credibility to the claims.

articles.title: Bloodbath at Rohtak hotel: How 'girlfriend' lured gangster into murder trap; 4 shot dead
articles.summary: Jhanvi Chaudhary allegedly posed as Sunny Ritolia's girlfriend to facilitate a murder plot by the Himanshu Bhau gang. On November 25, she brought Sunny to the Milan hotel, where armed assailants opened fire, resulting in four deaths.

articles.title: DMK formally backs Centre's delimitation Bill, Stalin calls it 'major victory' for Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: In a strategic move, the DMK has publicly backed the Centre's revised delimitation Bill, considering it a pivotal achievement for Tamil Nadu. Party officials articulated that the proposal successfully tackles their apprehensions about legislative representation and demographic allocation.

A house renovation in London uncovered a basket hidden behind a wall
articles.summary: In a fascinating archaeological find at Lauderdale House, London, a wicker basket dating back to the 17th century was unearthed, revealing hidden objects like broken shoes. These artifacts were once believed to safeguard homes from malevolent spirits.

C$470 million payout for Nova Scotia workers after court strikes down wage restriction law
articles.summary: Public sector workers in Canada's Nova Scotia province could receive up to C$5,000 each under a C$470 million compensation deal approved by a court. The settlement follows a ruling that declared a 2015 law restricting wage increases and long-service benefits unconstitutional.

articles.title: Indian Army Agniveer final result 2026 out: Region-wise merit list PDF released for IRO Delhi, NCR, AROs; check selection status, check complete details here
articles.summary: The Indian Army has released the Agniveer Final Result 2026 for multiple posts, including GD, Technical, Clerk, Tradesmen and Women Military Police. Candidates who appeared in the recruitment process can check their region-wise final merit lists in PDF format through the official website, joinindianarmy.nic.in.

articles.title: UP Sainik School admit card 2026 released at upsainikschool.org: Direct link to download hall tickets here
articles.summary: The UP Sainik Schools Society has released the admit cards for the UP Sainik School Entrance Examination 2026. Registered candidates can access their hall tickets through the official website, upsainikschool.org, using their registration number and date of birth.

articles.title: Lost his grandmother on UPSC prelims day, best friend before interview: How Madhya Pradesh's Shubham Shukla became an IPS officer with AIR 116
articles.summary: Shubham Shukla, who secured All India Rank 116 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2024, faced personal tragedies throughout his preparation. He lost his grandmother on the day of the preliminary examination and his closest friend shortly before the interview.

articles.title: BSSC Stenographer admit card 2026 released at bssc.bihar.gov.in: Direct link to download hall ticket here
articles.summary: The Bihar Staff Selection Commission (BSSC) has issued the Stenographer Admit Card 2026 for 531 Stenographer and Steno Typist Grade-III vacancies. Registered candidates can download their hall tickets from bssc.bihar.gov.in using their registration number and date of birth.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' day 23: Ranbir, Yash's film crosses Rs 1,000 crore net in India
articles.summary: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, has crossed the Rs 1,000 crore mark in net box office collections. The film achieved a cumulative net collection of Rs 1,000.55 crore after its 23rd day in theatres.

articles.title: Basil Joseph says Indian cinema’s hero image makes superhero films challenging
articles.summary: Basil Joseph engaged in a thought-provoking discussion at IFFI Goa about the complexities of crafting superhero films within Indian cinema. He emphasized the prevalence of male heroes endowed with supernatural abilities, which presents unique challenges in developing original storylines.

articles.title: Yami Gautam reveals how her love story with Aditya Dhar began
articles.summary: Yami Gautam and Aditya Dhar's relationship began during their collaboration on the film 'Uri: The Surgical Strike'. While they first built a professional connection, their friendship gradually developed into romance over time.

articles.title: Vijay Sethupathi reacts to Tom Hanks' praise for 'Maharaja'
articles.summary: Vijay Sethupathi was taken aback by Tom Hanks' reaction to his film 'Maharaja'. Hanks lauded the performance of Sachana Namidass, who portrays his daughter.
